req.title: Emit OpenAPI schema
req.statement: The system shall serve an OpenAPI 3.x JSON specification at GET /openapi.json.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-017 requires GET /openapi.json to return HTTP 2xx with a valid OpenAPI 3.x JSON payload. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — happy path returns 200 with correct Content-Type and required OpenAPI fields; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — response body is parseable JSON and contains exact app metadata strings matching main.py constants; (4) DT — verifying all mandatory OpenAPI 3.x top-level keys are present and non-empty; (5) STC — verifying the schema includes paths for known routes. Assertions use exact values to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

tests.name: test_openapi_json_returns_200_with_json_content_type
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable from main
trace: R-PLAYER-017: system shall serve OpenAPI 3.x JSON at GET /openapi.json
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_returns_200_with_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in response.headers['content-type']

test_openapi_json_returns_200_with_json_content_type()

preconditions: FastAPI app is importable from main
app is configured with title, description, version in main.py
actions: Assert exact metadata values match main.py constants
trace: R-PLAYER-017: expected payload must reflect app metadata
Catches constant-mutation on title/version strings in main.py
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_contains_exact_app_metadata():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert body['info']['title'] == 'python-samples-fastapi-restful'
    assert body['info']['version'] == '1.0.0'
    assert '🧪 Proof of Concept' in body['info']['description']

test_openapi_json_contains_exact_app_metadata()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_has_required_openapi3_top_level_keys():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert 'openapi' in body
    assert body['openapi'].startswith('3.')
    assert 'info' in body
    assert isinstance(body['info'], dict)
    assert len(body['info']) > 0
    assert 'paths' in body
    assert isinstance(body['paths'], dict)
    assert len(body['paths']) > 0

test_openapi_json_has_required_openapi3_top_level_keys()

preconditions: FastAPI app is importable from main
player_route and health_route are included in the app
actions: Assert known player and health paths are present in 'paths'
expected: '/health' or a health-related path is present OR at minimum '/players/' exists
trace: R-PLAYER-017: schema must reflect all registered routers
Catches mutations that drop router inclusion or path registration
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_paths_include_known_player_routes():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    paths = body['paths']
    assert '/players/' in paths
    assert 'get' in paths['/players/']
    assert 'post' in paths['/players/']
    assert '/players/{player_id}' in paths
    assert 'get' in paths['/players/{player_id}']

test_openapi_json_paths_include_known_player_routes()

tests.name: test_openapi_json_response_body_is_valid_json_not_empty
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable from main
actions: Assert response body parses to a dict with more than zero keys
expected: Dict has at least 3 top-level keys (openapi, info, paths)
trace: R-PLAYER-017: expected payload — boundary on minimum valid schema size
Catches mutations that return empty body or non-dict payload
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_response_body_is_valid_json_not_empty():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert len(response.text) > 0
    body = response.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert len(body) >= 3
    required_keys = {'openapi', 'info', 'paths'}
    assert required_keys.issubset(set(body.keys()))

test_openapi_json_response_body_is_valid_json_not_empty()
